## RandomPreset

RandomPreset is a reusable item list selected by name from cargo or attachment
rules in cfgspawnabletypes.xml.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 3 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### RandomPreset.name

Key: `name`

Paths:

* [`attachments`](#randompresetsfileattachments).`[]`.`name`
* [`cargo`](#randompresetsfilecargo).`[]`.`name`

Name is the identifier referenced by a spawn rule's `preset` attribute.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |
| Examples | `foodHermit` |

### RandomPreset.chance

Key: `chance`

Paths:

* [`attachments`](#randompresetsfileattachments).`[]`.`chance`
* [`cargo`](#randompresetsfilecargo).`[]`.`chance`

Chance is the probability, from 0 to 1, that this preset is selected when it is
one of the candidates.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `number` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `0.15` |
| Constraints | `minimum=0`; `maximum=1` |

### RandomPreset.item

Key: `item`

Paths:

* [`attachments`](#randompresetsfileattachments).`[]`.`item`
* [`cargo`](#randompresetsfilecargo).`[]`.`item`

Items are the candidates provided by this preset.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items reference | [`SpawnableItem`](#spawnableitem) (`#/$defs/SpawnableItem`) |
